Jhin.phase: Early on, count Jhin's shots, avoid his final shot, and use Ashe W Volley only when you can reliably hit. In the mid game, contribute to teamfights with slows and range. Late game, Ashe has less burst damage than other marksmen, so attack steadily from a safe position.
Jhin.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and slow enemies who engage with Ashe P Frost Shot and Ashe W Volley. Decide in advance whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to start a fight or stop an enemy who comes in. If someone must block shots from Jhin R Curtain Call, let the ally with the highest health percentage do it; Ashe should dodge the shots when low on health.

Kaisa.watch: If Kai'Sa W Void Seeker hits you, you may become a target for the dash from Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct. Retreat toward your allies until the mark disappears. When you expect Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain, stand beside allied minions to spread out the missiles. If you are low on health and Kai'Sa has built up passive stacks on you, move out of range and wait for them to expire.
Kaisa.build: Early, buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first against the physical damage from Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain and her basic attacks.
Kaisa.fight: In small skirmishes, let your support engage first, then keep the slow going with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks. If Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct is unavailable, stun her with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to give her less room to escape.
Kaisa.laning: After that, keep the wave closer to your side so Ashe, who has no mobility ability, does not push carelessly. Before moving forward, use Ashe E Hawkshot to check bushes and the enemy jungler's path. Use Ashe W Volley when you can reliably hit, given its mana cost and cooldown.
Kaisa.combo: Before a fight, use basic attacks on minions to stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus. Stun Kai'Sa from far away with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, add a slow with Ashe W Volley, then activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and continue with empowered attacks.
Kaisa.escape: At this point, if Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow hits, Kai'Sa cannot escape with her ultimate. Also look to engage after the movement speed boost or invisibility from Kai'Sa E Supercharge ends.
Kaisa.phase: Late game, Ashe has less burst damage than other marksmen, so watch for Kai'Sa's engage and move with your allies.
Kaisa.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and maintain slows with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks to delay Kai'Sa's approach. If Kai'Sa dives in with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, stun her with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to create a chance to kill her before the shield is removed. Before the fight, decide whether to use your ultimate to start it or stop Kai'Sa's engage.

Kalista.watch: If Kalista lands several spears with basic attacks, Kalista E Rend can deal heavy damage and slow you, so do not keep fighting with spears stacked on you. When Kalista starts a basic attack, anticipate her hop and prepare to hit Ashe W Volley or Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow. If Kalista's support moves close to her, prepare for Kalista R Fate's Call by moving away from the expected landing spot.
Kalista.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Kalista deals mostly physical damage, so build armor first, but remember that armor does not block the maximum-health-based damage from Kalista W Sentinel.
Kalista.fight: In short trades, keep your distance with the slows from Ashe W Volley and Ashe P Frost Shot, and back off if Kalista builds up spears on you. If your support engages first, keep the slow going with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks. If you stacked it beforehand, use Ashe Q Ranger's Focus for empowered attacks.
Kalista.laning: Ashe has no mobility ability, so keep the wave closer to your side instead of pushing carelessly, and use slows to make it harder for Kalista to approach. Early on, Ashe W Volley has a long cooldown and costs a lot of mana, so use it when you can reliably hit. Check paths without vision with Ashe E Hawkshot. Even while Kalista's basic attack is in flight, breaking vision with a bush or wall can reduce the damage you take.
Kalista.combo: Attack minions to stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus in advance. When Kalista starts a basic attack, predict the direction of her hop and stun her from far away with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow. Then slow her with Ashe W Volley, activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus, and continue attacking.
Kalista.escape: While Kalista R Fate's Call is unavailable, you have a chance to engage with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow. Kalista can still hop with Kalista P Martial Poise, so read her basic attack animation, predict where she will hop, and aim your abilities accordingly.
Kalista.phase: Early on, survive with Cloth Armor and a wave kept closer to your side while managing Kalista's spear stacks. In the mid game, contribute to teamfights with slows and range. Late game, stay behind your allies and maintain slows instead of relying on burst damage.
Kalista.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and slow approaching enemies with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks. Before a fight, decide whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to start it or stop an engage. If Kalista looks ready to throw her support with Kalista R Fate's Call, spread out.

Karma.watch: Karma Q Inner Flame has a dangerous area slow, so stand behind minions or outside its range to avoid it. If Karma R Mantra empowers Karma Q Inner Flame and its area hits you, leave the circle before it detonates again. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, move away to break the tether before it roots you.
Karma.build: Build magic resistance first against Karma's main damage. Also consider movement speed to break Karma W Focused Resolve's tether and escape the area of Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra.
Karma.fight: While Karma W Focused Resolve is available, Ashe should not step forward to start a fight. When your support engages, keep the slow going with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks. If Karma R Mantra empowers Karma E Inspire's shield, wait until the shield expires before going in.
Karma.laning: Ashe has no way to escape on her own, so avoid pushing the lane carelessly. Keep it pulled back and manage your distance. Use Ashe W Volley when Karma steps forward and you can reliably hit her; at low levels, conserve mana and mind its cooldown. Before stepping forward, use Ashe E Hawkshot to check unseen paths and the enemy jungler's route.
Karma.combo: Before a fight, basic attack minions to stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus. Once Karma W Focused Resolve is down and the shield from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra has ended, stun her from far away with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow. Follow with Ashe W Volley to slow her, then activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and keep basic attacking.
Karma.escape: Ashe's chance to go in comes after Karma W Focused Resolve is down. Look for the moment when Karma E Inspire's movement speed boost and shield have ended, then stun her with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow and keep her slowed.
Karma.phase: Early on, Ashe W Volley has a long cooldown and a high mana cost, so avoid Karma's poke and manage your distance. In the late game, Ashe has less burst than other marksmen, so stay behind your team and keep enemies slowed.
Karma.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and slow approaching enemies with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks. If Karma W Focused Resolve is available, it can interrupt your team's engage, so increase the distance and make her use it first. Before the fight, decide whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to start it or stop an enemy who dives in.

KogMaw.watch: When Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active, it extends his range and adds damage based on maximum health to his basic attacks. Use Ashe W Volley to slow him, keep your distance, and wait for it to expire. Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle reduces armor and magic resistance, so block it with minions or sidestep it; if it hits you, do not close the gap immediately. When low on health, avoid Kog'Maw R Living Artillery and recover out of vision. After killing him, move away from his body to avoid the explosion from Kog'Maw P Icathian Surprise.
KogMaw.build: Build magic resistance first against Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle, Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage, and Kog'Maw E Void Ooze. Also consider armor against his basic attacks' physical damage, but avoid stacking only health because Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage deals damage based on maximum health.
KogMaw.fight: While Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active, slow him with Ashe W Volley and keep your distance. Once it expires, if you dodge Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle, engage with your support, activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus, and pressure him with basic attacks.
KogMaw.laning: Ashe has no mobility ability, so do not push the lane blindly. Keep it pulled back and use the slow from Ashe P Frost Shot to keep Kog'Maw from approaching. Check bushes and the enemy jungler's route with Ashe E Hawkshot before stepping forward, and use Ashe W Volley when you can reliably hit. When you can push safely, disrupt Kog'Maw's farming and pressure the tower.
KogMaw.combo: Before a fight, attack minions to stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus. After Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends, stun him with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, follow with Ashe W Volley to keep him slowed, then activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and basic attack. If you kill him, walk back to avoid the explosion from Kog'Maw P Icathian Surprise.
KogMaw.escape: Kog'Maw has no mobility ability to create distance, so the end of Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is your chance to engage. After dodging Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle, close the gap and stun him with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow; he will struggle to escape. If Ashe is in danger, retreat out of vision while accounting for the slow from Kog'Maw E Void Ooze and Kog'Maw R Living Artillery, which grows stronger against targets with lower health.
KogMaw.phase: Early on, use Ashe W Volley sparingly and look for the end of Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage. Kog'Maw gets stronger over time, while Ashe has less late-game burst than other marksmen, so use early and mid-game advantages to end the game quickly.
KogMaw.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and slow the enemy's advance with Ashe P Frost Shot and Ashe W Volley. If an ally can engage, wait until Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends, then lock down Kog'Maw, who has no mobility ability, with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow and focus him. Before the fight, decide whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to start it or stop an enemy who dives in.

Leona.watch: If Leona E Zenith Blade hits, Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and Leona R Solar Flare can follow, so do not let her get close enough to engage. When she activates Leona W Eclipse, leave its area before it explodes. When the indicator for Leona R Solar Flare appears, move sideways to avoid the central stun.
Leona.build: Include armor penetration against Leona's high armor. Because being caught can be fatal, prioritize tenacity; choose resistances based on the damage type of the enemy carry attacking alongside Leona.
Leona.fight: Early on, do not start a trade with basic attacks because Leona has high armor. Once Leona E Zenith Blade is down, slow her with Ashe W Volley. When your support engages, activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and keep basic attacking.
Leona.laning: With no mobility ability, avoid pushing the lane carelessly. Keep it pulled back and manage your distance. Do not stand directly in line with your support, reducing the chance that Leona E Zenith Blade reaches the target behind them. Before stepping forward, use Ashe E Hawkshot to check unseen paths and the enemy jungler's route.
Leona.combo: Stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus on minions beforehand. Once Leona E Zenith Blade is down, stun her from a distance with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, add a slow with Ashe W Volley, then activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and keep basic attacking.
Leona.escape: Right after you make Leona use Leona E Zenith Blade is your chance to approach or pick her off. Check whether Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and Leona R Solar Flare are also down before going in, and land Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow while Leona E Zenith Blade is down to lock her down.
Leona.phase: Early on, Ashe's physical damage trades are unfavorable against Leona's high armor, so manage your distance and the lane. Later, Ashe has less burst than other marksmen, so keep applying slows from a safe position.
Leona.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and slow Leona's engage with Ashe P Frost Shot and Ashe W Volley. If you receive a mark from Leona P Sunlight, back away. Decide in advance whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to start the fight or stop Leona after she engages.

Lucian.watch: Lucian Q Piercing Light passes through minions and reaches beyond its displayed range, so do not stand in a straight line behind a minion Lucian is farming. Lucian cannot change the aim of Lucian R The Culling while casting it, so sidestep instead of running straight back. If the enemy support shields or heals Lucian, or an ally becomes immobilized, Lucian's next two shots are empowered; avoid trading then.
Lucian.build: Most of Lucian's damage is physical, and Ashe has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Early on, use Cloth Armor to survive and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Lucian.fight: Back away from Lucian's first combo. After he uses his abilities, counterattack with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks to slow him. Right after he uses Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is a chance to catch him, but do not extend the fight blindly: prolonged basic attack trades bring Lucian E Relentless Pursuit back quickly.
Lucian.laning: Ashe has no mobility ability, so do not push the lane carelessly. Keep it pulled back and use the slow from Ashe P Frost Shot to make it hard for Lucian to approach. Stay out of a straight line behind minions to avoid poke through them from Lucian Q Piercing Light, and use Ashe W Volley when you can reliably hit. Watch for the enemy jungler's approach and check unseen paths with Ashe E Hawkshot before stepping forward.
Lucian.combo: Right after Lucian uses Lucian E Relentless Pursuit, land Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow from a distance if possible to stun him. Follow with Ashe W Volley to slow him, then activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus, stacked beforehand with basic attacks, to land empowered basic attacks.
Lucian.escape: Go in right after Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is used. If you stun him with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow during that brief opening, he will struggle to escape with a mobility ability.
Lucian.phase: With items in the mid-game, Ashe contributes to teamfights through her slows and range. Late-game, stay behind your team and slow enemies instead of relying on burst damage.
Lucian.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and use Ashe P Frost Shot and Ashe W Volley to keep Lucian and other enemies slowed as they approach. Before the fight, decide whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to initiate or stop an enemy who dives in, and move with your team when they group up.

Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding hits you, follow-up abilities can land in quick succession. Avoid standing in line with an ally, and approach after it misses. Leave the area covered by Lux E Lucent Singularity, and dodge sideways when the red targeting line for Lux R Final Spark appears. If a Lux ability applies Lux P Illumination to you, stay out of Lux's basic attack range.
Lux.build: The available information does not identify a specific first purchase. Magic resistance helps against Lux's main damage; armor does not. Consider tenacity to reduce the damage you take after Lux Q Light Binding hits, and movement speed to leave the area covered by Lux E Lucent Singularity.
Lux.fight: Bait out Lux Q Light Binding and fight after it misses. Close the gap with the slows from Ashe W Volley and Ashe P Frost Shot, then keep dealing damage with basic attacks while Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active. Lux has no mobility ability and relatively low armor, so Ashe's physical damage is effective once you get close.
Lux.laning: Ashe has no mobility ability, so avoid pushing the wave carelessly and let it come toward you. Stand to the side of your ally: Lux Q Light Binding can pass through them and hit a second target. Use Ashe W Volley when you can land it reliably, and check bushes outside your vision and the enemy jungler's path with Ashe E Hawkshot before moving forward.
Lux.combo: Before a fight, basic attack minions to stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus. After Lux Q Light Binding misses, stun Lux with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow from a suitable distance. Follow with the slow from Ashe W Volley, activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus, and keep basic attacking.
Lux.escape: The moment after Lux Q Light Binding misses is your chance to engage. Lux has no mobility ability to create distance, so close the gap, stun her with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, and follow up with slows and basic attacks.
Lux.phase: Early on, let the wave come toward Ashe, dodge Lux Q Light Binding, and play safely. Later, Ashe has less burst damage than other marksmen, so fight from behind your allies while keeping enemies slowed.
Lux.teamfight: From behind your frontline, slow enemy approaches with Ashe W Volley and Ashe P Frost Shot. Do not group tightly with allies as you approach, so Lux E Lucent Singularity cannot catch you together. Before the fight, decide whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to start it or stop an enemy who engages.

Lulu.watch: You cannot attack while affected by Lulu W Whimsy, so do not move forward first while it is available. If the slow from Lulu Q Glitterlance and the knockup from Lulu R Wild Growth follow, Ashe, who has no escape ability, will be caught. If Lulu R Wild Growth is available, account for the target surviving even when a kill looks certain.
Lulu.laning: Stand behind minions to reduce the bonus damage from Lulu P Pix, Faerie Companion. Ashe has no escape ability, so do not push the wave carelessly. Once the wave is closer to you, use Ashe W Volley only when you can land it reliably. Before moving forward, use Ashe E Hawkshot to check bushes outside your vision and the enemy jungler's path.
Lulu.combo: Before a fight, attack minions to stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus. After Lulu W Whimsy is down, stun from long range with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, follow with the slow from Ashe W Volley, then activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and basic attack. If Lulu R Wild Growth is available, consider targeting Lulu herself before committing all your attacks to a target she can protect.
Lulu.phase: The available information does not establish which side is stronger early, so Ashe should keep her distance and harass steadily. In the mid game, contribute to teamfights with slows and range. In the late game, keep enemies slowed instead of relying on burst damage.
Lulu.teamfight: From behind your frontline, keep incoming enemies slowed with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks. Before the fight, decide whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to start it or stop an enemy who engages. If Lulu R Wild Growth is available, target Lulu herself or someone else instead of a target she can save with it.
Lulu.escape: Engage after Lulu W Whimsy is used on another ally. Lulu has no dash to escape on her own, so use that opening to close the gap and land Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to keep her in place.
Lulu.fight: Ashe has an opening to attack after Lulu uses Lulu W Whimsy on another ally. Until then, harass steadily from a safe distance with the slow from Ashe W Volley. If Lulu E Help, Pix! has been used on an allied carry and Lulu W Whimsy is also down, target Lulu herself.

MissFortune.watch: To avoid Miss Fortune Q Double Up, stand to the side rather than directly behind a minion. Do not start a fight in an area covered by Miss Fortune E Make It Rain. When Miss Fortune R Bullet Time starts, interrupt it with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow or move out to the side of its fixed cone.
MissFortune.build: Start with Cloth Armor to withstand her damage early. Miss Fortune's main damage is physical and Ashe has low armor, so build armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
MissFortune.fight: Immediately after Miss Fortune attacks a minion, create distance so you do not take an empowered basic attack. When your support starts a fight, keep her slowed with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks. When Miss Fortune tries to flee, damage her once to reset the movement speed from Miss Fortune W Strut.
MissFortune.laning: Ashe has no mobility ability, so avoid pushing the wave carelessly and let it come toward you. Do not stand in line with a minion, so the bouncing shot from Miss Fortune Q Double Up misses you. Use Ashe W Volley when you can land it reliably, accounting for its mana cost and cooldown, and check vision with Ashe E Hawkshot before moving forward.
MissFortune.combo: Before a fight, attack minions to stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus. Stun Miss Fortune from long range with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, then add a slow and damage with Ashe W Volley. Activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and follow with basic attacks.
MissFortune.escape: Miss Fortune has no mobility ability, so you can catch her with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow when you get a chance to close the gap. Do not engage in an area covered by Miss Fortune E Make It Rain. Move outside it to avoid the slow, then engage when your support does.
MissFortune.phase: Early on, withstand Miss Fortune's physical damage with Cloth Armor and a wave held closer to you. Later, Ashe has less burst damage than other marksmen, so do not step too far forward.
MissFortune.teamfight: From behind your frontline, keep incoming enemies slowed with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks. If Miss Fortune E Make It Rain covers the area, delay the fight there and move outside it. Decide in advance whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to start the fight or interrupt Miss Fortune R Bullet Time.

Morgana.watch: If Morgana Q Dark Binding hits, Morgana W Tormented Shadow and follow-up attacks will follow, so keep minions between you and Morgana as you move. When low on health, do not cross Morgana W Tormented Shadow. If Morgana R Soul Shackles links to you, leave its range before the stun triggers.
Morgana.build: Build magic resistance first against Morgana's magic damage. If Morgana Q Dark Binding and Morgana R Soul Shackles are a bigger problem for Ashe, who has no mobility ability, you can prioritize tenacity. If a long fight makes Morgana's healing a problem, consider healing reduction next.
Morgana.fight: Keep a distance and angle that let you dodge Morgana Q Dark Binding while slowing her with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks. Ashe's physical damage works well against Morgana's low armor, so keep attacking after your support engages. Do not use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow on a target protected by Morgana E Black Shield.
Morgana.laning: Avoid pushing the wave carelessly. Let it come toward you and keep minions between you and Morgana to dodge Morgana Q Dark Binding. Harass with Ashe W Volley when Morgana steps forward and you can land it reliably; at low levels, use it sparingly because of its mana cost and cooldown. Before moving forward, check bushes outside your vision and the enemy jungler's path with Ashe E Hawkshot.
Morgana.combo: Before a fight, attack minions to stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus. When Morgana E Black Shield is down, stun from long range with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, follow with the slow from Ashe W Volley, then activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and land empowered basic attacks.
Morgana.escape: Look to engage when Morgana Q Dark Binding has missed and Morgana E Black Shield is down. Morgana has no ability to create distance on her own, so after an ally starts the fight, close the gap with the slow from Ashe W Volley and keep attacking.
Morgana.phase: Early on, Ashe has trouble escaping if caught, so dodge Morgana Q Dark Binding and let the wave come toward you. Later, Ashe has less burst damage than other marksmen, so keep enemies slowed from a safe position.
Morgana.teamfight: From behind your frontline, keep incoming enemies slowed with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks. Before the fight, decide whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to start it or stop an enemy who engages. Do not waste the stun on a target protected by Morgana E Black Shield. If Morgana R Soul Shackles links to you, leave its range before the stun triggers.

Maokai.watch: Maokai W Twisted Advance dashes in and roots you, so stay away from the brush while it is available. Do not enter brush planted with Maokai E Sapling Toss. If a sapling follows you, lead it toward minions or monsters instead of allies. If Maokai R Nature's Grasp comes from far away, dodge perpendicular to its path and avoid narrow passages with no room to sidestep.

Magic resistance protects against Maokai's damage, but account for the enemy damage dealer who attacks while Maokai holds you when choosing resistances. Consider tenacity against the roots from Maokai W Twisted Advance and Maokai R Nature's Grasp.
Maokai.fight: While Maokai W Twisted Advance is available, Ashe should not step forward to start a trade. Right after it is used, follow your support's engage with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks to keep the enemy slowed. Use poke abilities on the enemy damage dealer so you do not make Maokai P Sap Magic's healing available again as often; attack Maokai with basic attacks.
Maokai.laning: Ashe has no mobility ability, so let the wave come toward you. Check the brush and enemy jungler's path with Ashe E Hawkshot before stepping forward. Given its mana cost and cooldown, use Ashe W Volley when you can reliably hit, such as when the enemy support steps forward. Keep your distance while Maokai W Twisted Advance is available, and move up to trade only after it is used.
Maokai.combo: Before a fight, basic attack minions to stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus. Once Maokai W Twisted Advance is used, stun him from long range with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, slow him with Ashe W Volley, then activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and keep basic attacking. Do not waste basic attacks during Maokai W Twisted Advance's dash; attack after he lands.
Maokai.escape: Right after Maokai W Twisted Advance is used is Ashe's window to close the distance. Stun him with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow and attack with your allies. Do not go in first while Maokai W Twisted Advance is available.
Maokai.phase: Early on, Ashe cannot escape on her own, so keep your distance and watch for Maokai W Twisted Advance. Later, Ashe has less burst damage than other marksmen, so do not fight from the front.
Maokai.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and maintain the slow from Ashe P Frost Shot to delay Maokai's engage. Before the fight, decide whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to start it or stop Maokai when he comes in. Fight alongside your team in open terrain with room to dodge Maokai R Nature's Grasp sideways.

When Milio W Cozy Campfire is active, the enemy marksman gains range; delay the frontline fight until it expires. The shield and movement speed from Milio E Warm Hugs, and the healing and tenacity from Milio R Breath of Life, also prolong fights.

Choose your resistances based on the enemy damage dealer's damage type, and buy healing reduction earlier if the healing from Milio W Cozy Campfire and Milio R Breath of Life becomes a problem.

Stacking Ashe Q Ranger's Focus on minions before the fight lets you use empowered basic attacks immediately. Milio has relatively low armor, so Ashe's physical damage is effective against him.

Poke with Ashe W Volley when Milio steps forward and you can reliably hit him, wearing him down. Before stepping forward, use Ashe E Hawkshot to check paths without vision and the enemy jungler's route.
Milio.combo: Before a fight, basic attack minions to stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus. Follow with Ashe W Volley for damage and a slow, then activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and keep using empowered basic attacks.

Check whether he has used Milio E Warm Hugs, since chasing him may be difficult if its movement speed boost is still active. After closing the distance, hold Milio in place with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow and slows.

Before the fight, decide whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to start it or stop an enemy who comes in. If Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is used and Milio becomes vulnerable, catch him with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to help cut off the enemy's healing support.

Nami.watch: Nami Q Aqua Prison stuns but falls slowly, so dodge sideways when you see its warning. Move sideways as soon as you see Nami R Tidal Wave, too. Do not fight an enemy affected by Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing head-on; keep your distance until it expires.
