Nami.fight: Before a fight, attack minions to stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus. If your support engages first, follow up with slows from Ashe W Volley and basic attacks, and target Nami, who has no mobility ability. Right after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses is your chance to attack.
Nami.laning: Ashe has no ability to escape on her own, so do not push the wave carelessly; fight with the wave closer to you. Use Ashe E Hawkshot to check the brush and paths the enemy jungler may take before stepping forward. Use Ashe W Volley when Nami steps forward and you can hit her.
Nami.combo: Stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus in advance, then, if possible, stun Nami from long range with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow. Follow with Ashe W Volley to slow her, then activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and use empowered basic attacks.
Nami.escape: Move toward Nami right after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses. If an enemy has Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing, wait for it to expire. Nami has no ability to create distance on her own, so close the gap and catch her with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow.
Nami.phase: Early on, Ashe should keep her distance because getting caught by Nami's crowd control makes follow-up hits likely. In the midgame, contribute to teamfights with slows and range. In the late game, account for Ashe's lower burst damage than other marksmen.
Nami.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and slow incoming enemies with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks. Dodge sideways when you see Nami R Tidal Wave, and watch for a follow-up Nami Q Aqua Prison. Decide in advance whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to start the fight or stop an enemy who comes in.

Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows larger and faster after hitting something first, so do not stand on top of allies or in a line with them. If Neeko approaches while disguised, the windup for Neeko R Pop Blossom may be hidden; spread out as soon as someone you suspect is Neeko gets close. Do not chase the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter; watch for the real Neeko.
Neeko.build: Build magic resistance first against the damage from Neeko Q Blooming Burst, Neeko W Shapesplitter, and Neeko E Tangle-Barbs. Get movement speed to leave telegraphed area attacks. If being rooted by Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and then hit by Neeko R Pop Blossom would kill you, prioritize tenacity over magic resistance.
Neeko.fight: When Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is used, keep your distance and trade with slows from Ashe W Volley and basic attacks. Stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus on minions before the fight, then use empowered basic attacks once it starts. Neeko's low armor makes Ashe's physical damage effective, but do not step forward first and get rooted.
Neeko.laning: Ashe has no ability to escape on her own, so do not push the wave carelessly; let it come toward you. Early on, Ashe W Volley has a long cooldown and high mana cost, so use it when Neeko steps forward and you can reliably hit her. Check brush without vision and the enemy jungler's path with Ashe E Hawkshot before stepping forward.
Neeko.combo: Stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus on minions in advance. During a window after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs or Neeko R Pop Blossom is used, stun her from long range with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, slow her with Ashe W Volley, then activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and keep basic attacking.
Neeko.escape: Right after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is used is your chance to approach and trade. Do not change direction to follow the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter; identify the real Neeko before going in.
Neeko.phase: Once Ashe has items in the midgame, her slows and range help in teamfights. In the late game, Ashe has less burst damage than other marksmen, so hold your position and keep enemies slowed.
Neeko.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and use Ashe W Volley and basic attacks to keep Neeko slowed as she approaches. Before the fight, decide whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to start it or stop Neeko when she comes in.

Nautilus.watch: Nautilus Q Dredge Line leads to a stun and engage, so keep minions between you and Nautilus to avoid it. If Nautilus P Staggering Blow roots you, he can follow up with more abilities, so stay out of his basic attack range. Nautilus R Depth Charge follows its target and knocks up allies along its path, so do not stand on top of your teammates.
Nautilus.build: Getting caught and hit by follow-up attacks is dangerous, so consider tenacity first. Build magic resistance against the magic damage from Nautilus Q Dredge Line, Nautilus W Titan's Wrath, and Nautilus E Riptide. Nautilus has high armor, so include armor penetration in your damage build.
Nautilus.fight: Trade immediately after Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses. Slow him with Ashe W Volley and follow with basic attacks, but do not move into range of Nautilus P Staggering Blow.
Nautilus.laning: Let the wave come toward you and stand behind minions to limit Nautilus Q Dredge Line engage angles. Check bushes and the enemy jungler's path with Ashe E Hawkshot before moving forward. Use Ashe W Volley when the enemy steps forward and you can reliably hit it.
Nautilus.combo: Before a fight, hit minions to stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus. Once Nautilus Q Dredge Line is down, stun him from long range with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, add a slow with Ashe W Volley, then activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and land empowered basic attacks.
Nautilus.escape: Right after Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses is Ashe's chance to close the distance. Stun Nautilus with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, then maintain the slow with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks. Back away if you enter range of Nautilus P Staggering Blow.
Nautilus.phase: Early on, Ashe has no mobility ability, so watch for Nautilus's engage first. In the mid game, Ashe contributes to teamfights with slows and range once she has items, but her late-game burst is lower than that of other marksmen.
Nautilus.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and keep slowing Nautilus with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks to delay his engage. Do not overlap with teammates along his engage path, so Nautilus R Depth Charge does not knock them up together. Decide beforehand whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to start the fight or stop Nautilus after he engages.

Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault targets and stuns you, so you cannot dodge it once you are in range. When Pantheon is with an ally, stand farther back to avoid the follow-up attacks. If you see the warning for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of its landing area.
Pantheon.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Pantheon's main damage is physical, so build armor first, though stacking only armor has limited value because of the penetration from Pantheon R Grand Starfall. Ashe's physical damage is also easily reduced by Pantheon's high armor, so include penetration when building more damage.
Pantheon.fight: When Pantheon uses Pantheon E Aegis Assault, stop attacking him from the front and wait for it to end, or attack from the side. Stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus on minions beforehand so you can use it as soon as the fight starts.
Pantheon.laning: Ashe has no mobility ability, so let the wave come toward you and avoid giving Pantheon an easy Pantheon W Shield Vault engage. Keep minions between you and Pantheon to avoid poke from Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Check paths without vision with Ashe E Hawkshot before moving forward. Ashe W Volley has a long cooldown and high mana cost early, so use it when you can reliably hit.
Pantheon.combo: After Pantheon's engage tool is down, stun him from long range with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow and add a slow with Ashe W Volley. Then activate your pre-stacked Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and attack with empowered basic attacks. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is blocking attacks from the front, wait for it to end or change your attack angle.
Pantheon.escape: Do not go in just because Pantheon W Shield Vault is down. Look for a window before Pantheon R Grand Starfall is back up as well, then stun him with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow and attack. If Pantheon W Shield Vault is available, Ashe should not step forward to start the fight.
Pantheon.phase: Pantheon's impact falls off toward the late game, but Ashe's late-game burst is also low, so attack continuously from a safe position.
Pantheon.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and keep slowing Pantheon with Ashe P Frost Shot and Ashe W Volley to delay his engage. Before the fight, decide whether Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow will start it or stop Pantheon after he engages. When Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks attacks from the front, change your attack angle or attack after it ends. Move out of the area when the warning for Pantheon R Grand Starfall appears.

Pyke.watch: Pyke E Phantom Undertow leaves a stun along his dash path, so dodge to the side of the path he traveled. If the shark shadow from Pyke W Ghostwater Dive appears beneath your feet, retreat toward allies or your turret. Keep your distance, since being pulled or pushed by Pyke Q Bone Skewer makes you vulnerable to follow-up attacks.
Pyke.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Pyke's damage is mostly physical, so build armor first, but also get enough health to stay above the execution threshold of Pyke R Death From Below. Buy Executioner's Calling earlier than usual to reduce the healing from Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones.
Pyke.fight: Do not step forward first. After your support starts a fight, keep slowing Pyke with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks. If you dodge Pyke E Phantom Undertow sideways, maintain your distance while attacking. After a trade, safely maintain vision to prevent healing from Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones.
Pyke.laning: Ashe has no mobility ability, so do not push the wave carelessly; let it come toward you. Poke with Ashe W Volley when Pyke steps forward and you can reliably hit him. At low levels, use it sparingly because of its mana cost and cooldown. Check bushes and the enemy jungler's path early with Ashe E Hawkshot, and use a Control Ward to gain vision of Pyke W Ghostwater Dive's approach route.
Pyke.combo: Before a fight, hit minions to stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus. Once Pyke's engage tools are down, stun him from long range with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow and add a slow with Ashe W Volley. Then activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and land empowered basic attacks.
Pyke.escape: Right after you dodge Pyke E Phantom Undertow is a chance to attack. However, if Pyke R Death From Below is still available, he has another way to move, so engage with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow during a window when Pyke R Death From Below is down too.
Pyke.phase: Early on, getting caught once makes Ashe vulnerable to follow-up attacks, so keep your distance and survive. In the mid game, Ashe contributes to teamfights with slows and range once she has items. Late in the game, prioritize consistent slows and safe positioning over burst damage.
Pyke.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and keep slowing Pyke with Ashe P Frost Shot and Ashe W Volley to delay his engage. Decide beforehand whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to start the fight or stop Pyke after he engages. Do not stand next to a low-health ally, or you may both be caught in Pyke R Death From Below.

Rell.watch: Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down dashes a short distance and knocks Ashe up, so stay outside its range while Rell is mounted. If Rell and one of her allies speed up together, it signals an engage with Rell E Full Tilt; stop trading and back away. Sidestep Rell Q Shattering Strike, and spread out from teammates before a teamfight so Rell R Magnet Storm cannot pull in several of you.
Rell.build: Ashe has no mobility ability and can easily die after being caught by Rell Q Shattering Strike and Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, so consider tenacity first. If building resistance, choose magic resistance over armor. Rell P Break the Mold reduces resistances and Rell E Full Tilt deals damage based on maximum health, so be cautious about simply stacking a lot of health.
Rell.fight: If Ashe steps forward to start a trade, Rell can easily catch her with an engage. Stay outside the range of Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down and slow her with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks. When your support starts a fight, follow up from behind. Immediately after Rell uses Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, create distance to leave her isolated.
Rell.laning: Ashe has no mobility ability, so let the wave come toward you instead of pushing it carelessly, and stay outside the range of Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Ashe W Volley has a long cooldown and high mana cost at low levels, so use it when Rell steps forward and you can reliably hit her. Before moving forward, use Ashe E Hawkshot to check bushes and the routes the enemy jungler could take.
Rell.combo: Before a fight, hit minions to stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus. Before Rell E Full Tilt comes back up, get enough distance to stun her with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow and slow her with Ashe W Volley. Then activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and attack with empowered basic attacks.
Rell.escape: Do not go in just because Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down is down. The window to engage with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is before Rell E Full Tilt comes back up as well. Immediately after Rell dismounts with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, create distance first, then join a fight an ally starts from behind.
Rell.phase: Early on, manage your distance to avoid Rell's engage and use Ashe W Volley only when you can reliably hit it while managing the wave. Late in the game, Ashe has less burst than other marksmen, so do not move ahead of your allies; keep applying slows from behind them.
Rell.teamfight: Before the engage, spread out from your teammates so Rell R Magnet Storm cannot pull in several of you. Ashe should stay behind her frontline and delay Rell's engage with slows from Ashe W Volley and basic attacks. Decide beforehand whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to start the fight or stop Rell after she engages.

Samira.watch: While Samira W Blade Whirl is spinning, it destroys projectiles, so use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow and basic attacks after it ends. If enemy support crowd control hits you, Samira can immediately close in with Samira P Daredevil Impulse, so dodge the support's opening ability first. Keep your distance: if Samira gets close and builds her Style grade, she can use Samira R Inferno Trigger.
Samira.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Samira's main damage and basic attacks are physical, and Ashe has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Samira.fight: Use Ashe's range advantage to slow Samira with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks as she walks in, then keep her time at close range short. Stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus by attacking minions before a fight so you can use empowered basic attacks immediately. Use projectiles and basic attacks after Samira W Blade Whirl ends.
Samira.laning: Ashe has no mobility ability, so avoid pushing the lane carelessly. Keep the wave near you and manage the angles Samira can use to walk in. Ashe W Volley has a long cooldown and high mana cost early, so use it when you can land it reliably. In skirmishes, add your slow after your support engages. Before moving forward, use Ashe E Hawkshot to check bushes without vision and the enemy jungler's path.
Samira.combo: Once Samira W Blade Whirl has ended and Samira has used Samira E Wild Rush, stun her from long range with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow. Follow with Ashe W Volley to slow her, then activate a pre-stacked Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and use empowered basic attacks.
Samira.escape: If Samira has used Samira E Wild Rush and no one has died, that moment while her dash has not reset is your window to fight. Confirm that Samira W Blade Whirl has also ended, then catch her with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow. Getting hit by the enemy support's crowd control signals Samira to engage, so dodge that ability before closing the distance.
Samira.phase: Early on, use Ashe's range and slow to keep Samira from approaching, but keep the wave near you and play safely because Ashe has no mobility ability. Later, Ashe has less burst than other marksmen, so maintain enough distance to keep Samira from getting close.
Samira.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and keep Ashe P Frost Shot's slow on Samira to delay her engage. When Samira R Inferno Trigger starts, interrupt it with the stun from Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow if Samira W Blade Whirl will not block it. If an ally is caught, expect Samira to dash in and respond. When retreating, do not leave a low-health ally behind.

Rakan.watch: Rakan W Grand Entrance knocks you up at its landing point after the dash, so step to the side of that point when he starts moving. When Rakan R The Quickness is active, stun him with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow before he reaches you or keep terrain between you. Do not line up with your allies.
Rakan.build: Rakan's threat comes from the crowd control he starts with Rakan W Grand Entrance and Rakan R The Quickness, so get a way to remove crowd control first. If building resistance against Rakan's damage, choose magic resistance.
Rakan.fight: Trade damage just after the shield from Rakan P Fey Feathers breaks. Do not move forward first. When your support engages, keep Rakan slowed with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks.
Rakan.laning: Ashe has no ability to escape on her own, so avoid pushing the lane carelessly and keep the wave near you. Poke when Rakan moves forward and you can reliably hit Ashe W Volley. Check paths without vision with Ashe E Hawkshot before advancing.
Rakan.combo: If Rakan W Grand Entrance is on cooldown and Rakan is separated from his allies, stun him from a distance with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow. Follow with Ashe W Volley to slow him, then activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus, stacked beforehand with basic attacks, and continue with empowered basic attacks.
Rakan.escape: The moment after you dodge the landing of Rakan W Grand Entrance or see him use it is your window to close the distance. Rakan E Battle Dance can only target allied champions, so catch Rakan with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow when he is alone and separated from his allies.
Rakan.phase: Early on, Ashe cannot use Ashe W Volley often, so watch for Rakan's engage and manage your distance. In the mid game, contribute to teamfights with slows and range. Late game, Ashe has less burst than other marksmen, so attack steadily from behind your allies.
Rakan.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and keep Rakan slowed with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks to delay his engage. Before a fight, decide whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to start it or to stop Rakan as he comes in. Do not line up with your allies, so Rakan R The Quickness cannot catch several of you together.

Renata.watch: Renata Glasc Q Handshake roots the first target it hits and can throw them, so dodge it from behind minions or your frontline. Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program travels in a straight line, dealing damage and slowing while shielding allies, so dodge sideways. In teamfights, spread out so Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover does not hit several allies together.
Renata.build: Prioritize Quicksilver Sash to deal with crowd control. If building resistance, choose magic resistance against the magic damage from Renata Glasc P Leverage, Renata Glasc Q Handshake, and Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program. Renata Glasc P Leverage scales with maximum health, so be careful about building only a lot of health.
Renata.fight: When Renata Glasc Q Handshake is on cooldown and your support engages, keep the slow going with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks. Renata Glasc has no mobility ability of her own, so if you get a chance to close the distance, target her with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow. Ashe has no way to escape on her own, so do not move forward first to start a fight.
Renata.laning: Ashe has no mobility ability, so keep the wave near you and use the slow from Ashe P Frost Shot to make it hard for Renata Glasc to approach. Ashe W Volley costs significant mana and has a long cooldown early, so use it when Renata Glasc steps forward and you can land it reliably. Before moving forward, use Ashe E Hawkshot to check bushes without vision and the enemy jungler's path.
Renata.combo: Before a fight, attack minions to stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus. Create some distance and stun Renata Glasc with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, then slow her with Ashe W Volley. Activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and continue with empowered basic attacks.
Renata.escape: Engage during the window when Renata Glasc Q Handshake is on cooldown and no allies would be caught together by Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover. Renata Glasc has no mobility ability of her own, so she will have trouble escaping if Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow hits her then.
Renata.phase: In the mid game, use Ashe's slow and range to guide fights. Late game, stay behind your allies and keep enemies slowed instead of relying on burst damage.
Renata.teamfight: While Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, keep space between you and your allies so it does not hit you together. From behind your frontline, use Ashe W Volley and basic attacks to slow enemies coming in. Decide beforehand whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to start the fight or stop an enemy who engages.

Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness passes through allies or minions in a straight line, so move off the line between Senna and those targets. Dodge Senna W Last Embrace from behind minions. If it hits you and applies its mark, move away from allies before the root spreads. If Senna hits you once, back off to deny a second attack and prevent her from collecting Mist.
Senna.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Senna's main damage is physical and Ashe has low armor, so prioritize armor.
Senna.fight: When Senna steps forward to collect a soul, slow her with Ashe W Volley and follow with basic attacks from a safe position. Stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus by attacking minions before a fight so you can use empowered basic attacks from the start. Follow up with damage when your support engages first; do not move forward alone to start a fight.
Senna.laning: Ashe has no mobility ability, so avoid pushing the lane carelessly and keep the wave near you. Watch where Senna will step forward to collect souls, but use Ashe W Volley when you can land it reliably to conserve mana and protect your last hits. Before moving forward, use Ashe E Hawkshot to check bushes and the enemy jungler's path.
Senna.combo: When you get a chance to close the distance to Senna, stun her with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, then use Ashe W Volley for a slow and damage. Activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and follow with basic attacks. Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow stuns longer when it hits from farther away, so fire it from a distance when possible.
Senna.escape: After Senna uses Senna W Last Embrace, you have an opportunity to move in while avoiding the root. Do not chase too hard while Senna E Curse of the Black Mist gives her increased movement speed. Catch her with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow when you can close the distance.
Senna.phase: Senna has low health and attack damage early, giving Ashe chances to poke safely and prevent her from collecting souls. Later, Senna's range and attack damage grow while Ashe has less burst, so it is important to pressure Senna from the early game.
Senna.teamfight: From behind your frontline, keep incoming enemies slowed with basic attacks and Ashe W Volley. When you see Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, back off to an area with vision or use Ashe W Volley on the mist. Before a fight, decide whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to start it or stop an enemy who comes in.

Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots targets who are already slowed and stuns targets who are immobilized. If you are slowed, first move out of the straight path in front of Seraphine. Seraphine R Encore gains range each time it hits an allied champion, so do not line up with your teammates.
Seraphine.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Seraphine P Stage Presence, Q High Note, and E Beat Drop. Armor does not help against this damage.
Seraphine.fight: Trade right after Seraphine E Beat Drop misses. Slow her with Ashe W Volley, then follow with empowered basic attacks from Ashe Q Ranger's Focus if you have stacked it beforehand. It is also a good time to fight when Seraphine is alone and away from her allied marksman.
Seraphine.laning: Ashe has no mobility ability, so do not push the lane carelessly; keep it closer to your side. Ashe W Volley is hard to use often early, so use it when Seraphine steps forward and you can reliably hit her. Check bushes without vision and the enemy jungler's path with Ashe E Hawkshot before moving forward.
Seraphine.combo: Hit minions before a fight to stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus. Once Seraphine E Beat Drop is down, stun her from a distance with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, add a slow with Ashe W Volley, then activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and continue with basic attacks.
Seraphine.escape: Go in right after Seraphine E Beat Drop misses. Seraphine has no mobility ability, so use the slows from Ashe W Volley and Ashe P Frost Shot to close the gap, then catch her with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow.
Seraphine.phase: Early on, use Ashe W Volley sparingly and manage your spacing and the lane. In mid game, contribute to fights with slows and range. In late game, focus on slowing enemies rather than burst damage.
Seraphine.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and keep slowing enemies with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks to delay their engage. Do not line up with teammates, so Seraphine R Encore cannot extend through them. Decide beforehand whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to start the fight or stop an enemy who dives in.

Sivir.watch: Sivir Q Boomerang Blade can hit on both its outward and return paths. If the first hit lands, step out of its return path. Sivir E Spell Shield blocks one ability, so do not fire Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow first while the shield is still active. When Sivir R On The Hunt is active, her whole team gains speed, so avoid chasing or retreating slowly.
Sivir.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. The main damage from Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and Sivir W Ricochet is physical, so build armor first.
Sivir.fight: Use Ashe W Volley when you can reliably hit to apply a slow, then stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus with basic attacks. Before engaging, draw out Sivir E Spell Shield, then stun her with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow.
Sivir.laning: Ashe has no mobility ability, so do not push the lane carelessly. Keep the wave closer to your side and use the slow from Ashe P Frost Shot to make it hard for Sivir to approach. If you leave Sivir alone in lane, her fast wave clear can damage your turret. Push the wave first or have a teammate catch it before leaving. Check bushes without vision and the enemy jungler's path with Ashe E Hawkshot.
Sivir.combo: Hit minions before a fight to stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus. First draw out Sivir E Spell Shield, then attack in this order: stun with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, slow with Ashe W Volley, activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus, and follow with empowered basic attacks.
Sivir.escape: Once Sivir E Spell Shield is down, you have a chance to engage with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow. Sivir has no blink, so closing the gap and landing the stun makes her easier to catch. Do not chase for long if Sivir R On The Hunt is active.
Sivir.phase: In mid game, contribute to teamfights with your completed items, slows, and range. In late game, Ashe has less burst damage than other marksmen, so stay behind your teammates and keep applying slows.
Sivir.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and slow enemies who engage with Ashe P Frost Shot and Ashe W Volley. If Sivir E Spell Shield is down, look for a chance to catch Sivir. Decide beforehand whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to start the teamfight or stop an engage. While Sivir R On The Hunt is active, take only short fights around terrain and vision.

Smolder.watch: Avoid Smolder W Achooo! by standing behind minions or moving sideways. When Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! lands, move out of its center and away from the flames beneath Smolder, then reengage.
Smolder.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Smolder's damage is mostly physical and Ashe has low armor, so build armor first. The true damage from Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath cannot be reduced by resistances, and it also deals damage based on maximum health, so do not rely on stacking health alone.
Smolder.fight: Pressure Smolder early, before he builds up his scaling stacks, but do not step forward alone to start a fight. When your support engages, use the slows from Ashe W Volley and basic attacks to keep Smolder in range. Stacking Ashe Q Ranger's Focus on minions before the fight lets you use empowered basic attacks immediately.
Smolder.laning: Disrupt Smolder's early farming so he cannot scale by killing minions with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath. Ashe has no mobility ability, so do not push the lane carelessly, and use Ashe W Volley when you can reliably hit. Before moving forward, check bushes and the enemy jungler's path with Ashe E Hawkshot.
Smolder.combo: Once Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down, stun him with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, then slow him with Ashe W Volley. Activate your prepared Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and follow with empowered basic attacks. If there is no urgency, fire Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow from a distance toward the direction Smolder will move.
Smolder.escape: Right after you force out Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap, his only escape, is your chance to go in. Use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to cut off his escape route and close the gap with your teammates. If you have dodged Smolder W Achooo!, you can also avoid being slowed and hit by the follow-up attacks.
Smolder.phase: Smolder is weakest early, before he has built up his scaling stacks. Deny his farm and pressure him then. Smolder gains an advantage as time passes, so take turrets and objectives quickly and aim to finish in mid game.
Smolder.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and keep slowing enemies with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks to delay their engage. Before the fight, decide whether Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow will start it or stop an incoming enemy. Avoid the center of Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! and the flames beneath Smolder. Once Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down, look for a chance to catch him with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow.

Soraka.watch: Hitting Ashe with Soraka Q Starcall heals Soraka and increases her movement speed, so dodge it while continuing to pressure her. Entering the area of Soraka E Equinox can silence and root you, so avoid stepping into it.
Soraka.build: Soraka Q Starcall and Soraka E Equinox both deal magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance if you build resistances. If her healing makes fights drag on, consider healing reduction next.
Soraka.fight: When Soraka E Equinox is down and your support engages, keep applying slows with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks. Rather than spending too long attacking an enemy Soraka is healing, focus Soraka herself when you can reach her.
Soraka.laning: Ashe has no mobility ability, so keep the wave closer to your side and check the enemy jungler's path and bushes with Ashe E Hawkshot before moving forward. Harass Soraka with Ashe W Volley when she steps forward and you can reliably hit her. Dodge Soraka Q Starcall so she does not get a chance to heal.
Soraka.combo: Hit minions before a fight to stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus. Once Soraka E Equinox is down, stun her with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, slow her with Ashe W Volley, then activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and follow with empowered basic attacks.
Soraka.escape: Right after Soraka E Equinox is used is your chance to go in. If its area remains, use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow before stepping into it, and follow after your support engages first.
Soraka.phase: In mid game, Ashe can contribute to teamfights with her items, slows, and range. Her late-game burst damage is weaker than that of other marksmen, so concentrate your damage into a short window against Soraka's healing.
Soraka.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and keep slowing incoming enemies with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks. If an opening to reach Soraka appears, catch her with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow and focus her. Before the fight, decide whether to use that ultimate to start it or stop an enemy engage.

Swain.watch: Swain E Nevermove travels out and back, so even after dodging the first wave, stay out of its path until it disappears completely.
Swain.build: Ashe's physical damage is effective against Swain's low armor. If you need defensive items, build magic resistance first against Swain's magic damage, and get healing reduction if you expect a long fight.
Swain.fight: The moment Swain E Nevermove is down is your chance to engage. Keep your distance and slow him with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks. If Swain activates Swain R Demonic Ascension, retreat out of range and fight again after it ends.
Swain.laning: Pressure Swain early to keep him from building scaling stacks, but do not push the lane carelessly with immobile Ashe. Last-hit near maximum range, use Ashe W Volley when you can reliably land it, and check paths without vision with Ashe E Hawkshot.
Swain.combo: Attack minions before a fight to stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus. Once Swain E Nevermove is down, stun him from a distance with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, slow him with Ashe W Volley, then activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and land empowered basic attacks.
Swain.escape: Go in right after dodging the returning wave of Swain E Nevermove. Swain has no escape ability, so catching him with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow and keeping him slowed can create a chance to kill him.
Swain.phase: It is best for Ashe to pressure Swain early, before he has built scaling stacks, to slow his growth. In the mid game, once Ashe has items, her slows and range can help in teamfights. As time goes on, Swain's permanent scaling and healing become harder to handle, while Ashe's late-game burst is relatively weaker.
Swain.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and keep enemies slowed with Ashe P Frost Shot and Ashe W Volley to delay their engage. When Swain R Demonic Ascension is active, move out of range instead of continuing to fight nearby, and wait for it to end. Decide beforehand whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to start the fight or stop Swain when he engages.

Sona.watch: Sona R Crescendo stuns multiple targets in a line, so spread out sideways from your allies when Sona steps forward. If Sona has an empowered attack from Sona P Power Chord ready and enters basic attack range, back away. She can escape with Sona E Song of Celerity, so do not rely on slows alone to chase her.
Sona.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Sona P Power Chord, Sona Q Hymn of Valor, and Sona W Aria of Perseverance. The healing from Sona W Aria of Perseverance is effective in extended fights, so get Executioner's Calling on Ashe as a physical damage dealer.
Sona.fight: When Sona steps forward to apply an aura and your support engages, keep her slowed with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks. Trading damage from early on can pressure Sona's mana by forcing her to heal with Sona W Aria of Perseverance. If you have a chance to kill her before she escapes with Sona E Song of Celerity, stun her first with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow.
Sona.laning: Ashe has no mobility ability, so do not push the lane carelessly. Keep it pulled toward you and look for the moment Sona steps forward. Ashe W Volley is costly to use often early, so use it when Sona steps up to apply an aura and you can reliably hit her. Before moving forward, check bushes and the enemy jungler's path with Ashe E Hawkshot.
Sona.combo: Attack minions before a fight to stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus.
Sona.escape: When Sona R Crescendo is down, Sona stepping forward to apply an aura is a chance to engage. Stun her with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow before she activates Sona E Song of Celerity, preventing her from escaping with its movement speed.
Sona.phase: Early on, Sona has few scaling stacks from Sona P Power Chord and faces heavy mana demands, so Ashe should pressure her aggressively. In the mid game, Ashe can contribute to teamfights with her slows and range once she has items, but Sona also grows stronger over time. Late game, Sona's healing and shields become more effective the longer a fight lasts, so look for a chance to kill her before the fight drags on.
Sona.teamfight: Ashe stays behind her frontline and keeps enemies slowed with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks to delay their engage. Do not stand in a line with your allies where Sona R Crescendo can hit several of you. Decide beforehand whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to start the fight or stop an enemy who engages. If targeting Sona, stun her to disrupt her positioning and make it harder for her aura to reach a group of allied champions.

Taric.watch: Taric E Dazzle is a telegraphed stun. Watch both Taric and the ally linked by Taric W Bastion, and dodge sideways. When the damage immunity from Taric R Cosmic Radiance activates, stop attacking and deal damage again when it ends.
Taric.build: The available information is not enough to determine your first purchase. Taric P Bravado and Taric E Dazzle deal magic damage, so choose magic resistance if you build resistances.
Taric.fight: After dodging Taric E Dazzle, trade damage while keeping your distance with slows from Ashe W Volley and basic attacks. If Taric cannot reach a target to basic attack, he also cannot use Taric P Bravado to reduce his ability cooldowns.
Taric.laning: Ashe has no mobility ability, so do not push the lane carelessly; keep it pulled toward you. Harass Taric or his linked ally with Ashe W Volley when they step forward, and check paths without vision with Ashe E Hawkshot before advancing.
Taric.combo: Attack minions before a fight to stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus. When Taric E Dazzle is down and you have an opening to engage, stun him from a distance with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, follow with the slow from Ashe W Volley, then activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and basic attack.
Taric.escape: The moment you dodge Taric E Dazzle is your chance to go in. Taric has no ability to create distance on his own, so hold him with Ashe's slows. Landing Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow makes escaping even harder for him.
Taric.phase: Early on, watch out for damage from Taric's melee basic attacks and keep your distance. Late game, Ashe has less burst than other marksmen, so stay in a safe position and maintain your slows.
Taric.teamfight: From behind your frontline, use Ashe's slows to delay Taric and other enemies who engage. When Taric R Cosmic Radiance grants damage immunity, do not pour damage into it. If needed, hold them with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to let its duration pass, then attack again.

Tristana.watch: Tristana W Rocket Jump serves both to engage and escape. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is not ready, do not engage carelessly while both Tristana W Rocket Jump and Tristana R Buster Shot are available. Stand away from allied minions to avoid the area damage from Tristana E Explosive Charge when Tristana kills a minion.
Tristana.fight: Close the distance right after forcing Tristana W Rocket Jump, then catch her with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow. In a skirmish, let your support engage first, then keep Tristana slowed with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks.
Tristana.laning: Ashe has no mobility ability, so generally keep the lane pulled toward you and use the slow from Ashe P Frost Shot to stop Tristana from approaching. If you can push safely, push to Tristana's turret to make it harder for her to last-hit. Before moving forward, check bushes and the enemy jungler's path with Ashe E Hawkshot, and use Ashe W Volley when you can reliably land it.
Tristana.combo: When Tristana W Rocket Jump is down, stun her with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, slow her with Ashe W Volley, then activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and follow up with empowered basic attacks. Stacking Ashe Q Ranger's Focus on minions before the fight lets you use empowered basic attacks immediately.
Tristana.escape: The moment you force Tristana W Rocket Jump is your chance to go in. If both Tristana W Rocket Jump and Tristana R Buster Shot are ready, engage only when you can catch her with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow.
Tristana.phase: Tristana is weak early and has long cooldowns, so Ashe should harass her when it is safe. Tristana becomes difficult to handle with a completed build, so aim to finish the game before then.
Tristana.teamfight: Ashe stays behind her frontline and keeps an engaging Tristana slowed with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks. Before the fight, decide whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to start it or stop Tristana when she engages. If an ally falls and Tristana W Rocket Jump resets, retreat together rather than leaving a vulnerable ally in front.

Thresh.watch: Thresh Q Death Sentence catches Ashe and exposes her to follow-up attacks, so move sideways when you see him raise his hook. Change direction once more as you step up for a last hit, and avoid the line between Thresh and his ally so Thresh E Flay cannot pull you in.
Thresh.build: Getting caught by Thresh Q Death Sentence or Thresh E Flay is dangerous, so prioritize tenacity. If you build resistance against Thresh's ability damage, choose magic resistance over armor.
Thresh.fight: When Thresh walks forward to collect a soul, look to trade with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks. Do not step forward to start the fight; dodge Thresh Q Death Sentence first, then close the gap.
Thresh.laning: Ashe has no escape ability, so avoid pushing the wave carelessly and keep it near your side. Check bushes and the enemy jungler's path with Ashe E Hawkshot before stepping forward. Use Ashe W Volley when Thresh steps up and you can reliably hit him.
Thresh.combo: Attack minions before the fight to stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus. Before Thresh W Dark Passage is available again, stun him from long range with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, apply a slow with Ashe W Volley, then activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and keep attacking.
Thresh.escape: Right after you sidestep Thresh Q Death Sentence is your chance to close the gap. If Thresh W Dark Passage is also down, you can engage with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, but avoid positions where Thresh E Flay can pull you in.
Thresh.phase: Early on, keep your distance and let the wave push toward you, since Ashe struggles to escape if caught. Late game, her burst damage falls behind other marksmen, so stay behind your allies and keep enemies slowed.
Thresh.teamfight: From behind your frontline, slow approaching enemies with Ashe P Frost Shot and Ashe W Volley. Before the fight, decide whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to start it or to stop Thresh when he engages. If Thresh W Dark Passage is thrown, finish off the target immediately or retreat.

TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate W Pick a Card has locked in a gold card, stay outside his basic attack range; one attack will stun you. Stand behind minions to reduce damage from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards.
TwistedFate.build: The available information does not determine your first purchase. If you build a defensive stat, choose magic resistance against the magic damage from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, and Twisted Fate E Stacked Deck.
TwistedFate.fight: Do not enter basic attack range first while Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's gold card is available. Once he uses the card, slow him with Ashe W Volley and follow with basic attacks. If you stacked Ashe Q Ranger's Focus beforehand, you can use empowered attacks from the start of the fight.
TwistedFate.laning: Ashe has no mobility ability, so avoid pushing the wave carelessly and keep it near your side. Dodge Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from behind minions, and use Ashe W Volley when you can reliably hit. Before stepping forward, check unseen paths with Ashe E Hawkshot.
TwistedFate.combo: Stun from long range with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, then deal damage and apply a slow with Ashe W Volley. Activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and follow with empowered basic attacks. Attack minions before the fight to stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus so you can use it immediately.
TwistedFate.escape: Right after Twisted Fate uses the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card is your chance to engage.
TwistedFate.phase: In the mid game, use Ashe's slows and range in teamfights. Late game, move with your allies, bearing in mind that Ashe has less burst damage than other marksmen.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Ashe should stay behind her frontline and slow approaching enemies with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks. If you see Twisted Fate R Destiny's teleport and it is in range, you can interrupt it with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow. Before the fight, decide whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to initiate or to stop an enemy who engages.

Varus.watch: If Varus hits you with an ability after his basic attacks have applied Blight stacks, it triggers damage based on your maximum health. If you have taken several basic attacks, retreat and give the stacks time to expire. When you see Varus Q Piercing Arrow being aimed, step sideways out of its path. If an ally is rooted by Varus R Chain of Corruption, move away so its tendrils cannot reach you.
Varus.build: Early on, survive with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first because Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows deal physical damage. Armor does not block the magic damage from Varus W Blighted Quiver and Varus R Chain of Corruption.
Varus.fight: When Varus's basic attacks have applied Blight stacks, retreat instead of continuing to trade and taking an ability hit too. If you sidestep Varus Q Piercing Arrow while he aims, you have a chance to close in on Varus while he is slowing himself. When your support engages, apply slows with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks so Varus cannot close the gap.
Varus.laning: Ashe has no mobility ability, so avoid pushing the wave carelessly and keep it near your side. At low levels, Ashe W Volley has a long cooldown and high mana cost, so use it when you can reliably hit. Before stepping forward, check unseen bushes and the enemy jungler's path with Ashe E Hawkshot.
Varus.combo: Attack minions before the fight to stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus. Stun Varus from a distance with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, slow him with Ashe W Volley, then activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and land empowered basic attacks.
Varus.escape: Varus has no ability to create distance on his own, so look for a chance to close the gap after Varus R Chain of Corruption misses. When he aims Varus Q Piercing Arrow, you can also sidestep its path and then close in. Stun him with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow at that point to keep him from escaping.
Varus.phase: Early on, use Ashe W Volley sparingly and withstand Varus's physical damage with Cloth Armor. In the mid game, use your slows and range to drive fights. Late game, stay behind your allies and keep enemies slowed instead of relying on burst damage.
Varus.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and slow enemies with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks to delay their engage. Spread out so Varus R Chain of Corruption cannot spread to several allies, and do not move close even if an ally is rooted. Decide beforehand whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to start the fight or stop an enemy who engages. Avoid fighting briefly right after Varus grows stronger from a kill or assist.

Twitch.watch: Twitch can approach with Twitch Q Ambush, so when he disappears from lane, avoid unseen paths and alert your allies. Leave the cloud from Twitch W Venom Cask immediately. If you have taken several basic attacks, create distance before Twitch E Contaminate hits you, even if you still have health left. When Twitch activates Twitch R Spray and Pray, his range increases and his attacks pierce through targets, so do not line up with your allies.
Twitch.build: Buy a Control Ward first against Twitch Q Ambush. Twitch E Contaminate deals two types of damage, so building only one type of resistance will not block all of it. Resistance does not reduce the true damage from Twitch P Deadly Venom. The available information does not determine a specific later purchase or which resistance to prioritize.
Twitch.fight: Attack minions before the fight to stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus. When your support engages first, keep enemies slowed with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks. Do not continue trading inside the cloud from Twitch W Venom Cask. When Twitch's camouflage ends and his position is revealed, stun him with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow and focus him.
Twitch.laning: Ashe has no escape, so avoid pushing the wave carelessly and keep it near your side. Check unseen bushes and approach routes with Ashe E Hawkshot before stepping forward. Ashe W Volley is hard to use often early on, so use it when you can reliably hit. Alert your allies when Twitch disappears.
Twitch.combo: When you have a chance to start a fight, stun Twitch with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, then slow him with Ashe W Volley. Activate your pre-stacked Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and follow with empowered basic attacks. Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow stuns longer when it hits from farther away, so fire it from a distance when possible.
Twitch.escape: Engage when the camouflage from Twitch Q Ambush ends, revealing his position, and you can avoid the cloud from Twitch W Venom Cask. Twitch has no ability to create distance on his own, so once you close the gap, you can stun him with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow and keep him in place.
Twitch.phase: Early on, use Ashe W Volley sparingly, keep the wave near your side, and play safely. Late game, Ashe has less burst damage than other marksmen, but the available information does not establish whether Ashe or Twitch is stronger.
Twitch.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and use the slow from Ashe P Frost Shot to delay engaging enemies. When Twitch R Spray and Pray is active, spread out sideways so its piercing attacks do not hit you together. When Twitch's camouflage ends or he takes position, hit him with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow and focus him with your allies.

Vayne.watch: If Vayne E Condemn knocks you into a wall, it stuns you, so avoid fighting with your back to a wall. Vayne W Silver Bolts deals true damage based on maximum health after enough hits on the same target. Count the hits and move out of range just before it triggers. During Vayne R Final Hour, each Vayne Q Tumble briefly makes her invisible. Attack when she reappears.
Vayne.build: Early on, withstand damage with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first against Vayne's primarily physical damage, but armor cannot reduce the true damage from Vayne W Silver Bolts, so do not keep taking hits.
Vayne.fight: Right after you make Vayne use Vayne Q Tumble is your chance to close the gap. Before the fight, hit minions to stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus. If your support engages first, keep Vayne slowed with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks. Back away just before Vayne W Silver Bolts procs.
Vayne.laning: Pressure Vayne during her weak early game, but do not push the wave recklessly when Ashe has no mobility ability. Use Ashe W Volley when you can land it reliably.
Vayne.combo: After Vayne uses Q Tumble, stun her with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, then apply slow and damage with Ashe W Volley. Activate your pre-stacked Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and follow up with empowered basic attacks. If Vayne R Final Hour is active, do not rush your attacks while she is invisible; hit her when she reappears.
Vayne.escape: Go in immediately after Vayne uses Q Tumble. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow lands then, Vayne will have trouble escaping. Close the gap while avoiding positions where Vayne E Condemn could stun you against a wall.
Vayne.phase: Early on, pressure Vayne's low health and armor to disrupt her farming. Late game, her damage becomes difficult to withstand with defensive stats alone, so secure your advantage before then.
Vayne.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and slow an approaching Vayne with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks. Avoid narrow passages where Vayne E Condemn could knock you into a wall; fight in open space. Before the fight, decide whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to engage or to stop Vayne when she comes in.

Velkoz.watch: Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission splits in two even after you dodge the initial projectile, so don't just sidestep it; move behind its path after it passes. If Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption knocks you up, taking more abilities in succession can trigger the true damage from Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction. If you have stacks, back off and let them expire.
Velkoz.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can leave the areas Vel'Koz places. Magic resistance helps against Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission, W Void Rift, and E Tectonic Disruption. Rely on your total health to withstand the true damage from Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction and R Life Form Disintegration Ray.
Velkoz.fight: After dodging Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, follow your support's engage by holding him in place with slows from Ashe W Volley and basic attacks. Stacking Ashe Q Ranger's Focus on minions before the fight lets you use empowered basic attacks immediately.
Velkoz.laning: Ashe has no mobility ability, so keep the wave pulled toward you instead of pushing recklessly, and poke Vel'Koz when he steps forward. You cannot use Ashe W Volley often early on, so use it when you can land it reliably. Before moving up, use Ashe E Hawkshot to check bushes and the enemy jungler's path.
Velkoz.combo: Stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus with basic attacks before the fight. Once Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption is down, stun him from long range with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, add a slow with Ashe W Volley, then activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and continue attacking.
Velkoz.escape: Vel'Koz has no mobility ability, so your chance to close the gap comes immediately after you dodge Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption. Landing Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow then makes it hard for him to escape, but getting too close can let Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption knock you away.
Velkoz.phase: Early on, use Ashe W Volley carefully and keep the wave pulled toward you to avoid Vel'Koz's ability combos. Later, stay behind your team and maintain slows instead of relying on burst damage.
Velkoz.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and slow enemies who engage with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks. When Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray starts, prioritize interrupting it with the stun from Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow. Before the fight, decide whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to engage or to interrupt his beam.

Xayah.watch: Xayah E Bladecaller roots you if three or more returning feathers hit you. If at least three feathers lie along the line between you and Xayah, move sideways immediately. Xayah W Deadly Plumage increases her attack speed and movement speed, so do not stand in place and trade for long.
Xayah.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Xayah's damage is mostly physical, and Ashe has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Xayah.fight: Take short trades, slowing Xayah with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks, then reposition before feathers build up along the return path of Xayah E Bladecaller. Add your slow after your support engages, and look to go in when Xayah R Featherstorm is down.
Xayah.laning: Ashe has no mobility ability, so do not push the wave recklessly. Keep it pulled toward you and use slows to poke Xayah when she approaches. Early on, Ashe W Volley has a long cooldown and a high mana cost, so use it when you can land it reliably. Use Ashe E Hawkshot to check bushes and the enemy jungler's path before moving up.
Xayah.combo: Before the fight, basic attack minions to stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus. If Xayah R Featherstorm is down, stun her from long range with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, land Ashe W Volley, then activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and follow up with empowered basic attacks.
Xayah.escape: If Xayah uses E Bladecaller, dodge the returning feathers before going in, and land Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow during that opening.
Xayah.phase: Later, Ashe has less burst damage than other marksmen, so stay behind your team and keep applying slows.
Xayah.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and slow approaching enemies with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks. If Xayah R Featherstorm is available, do not fire Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow hastily; look for the stun after Xayah uses her R.

Xerath.watch: Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions, so standing behind them does not keep you safe. When Xerath starts charging it, change direction and dodge sideways. Be especially careful of the stun from Xerath E Shocking Orb, which can leave you open to follow-up attacks. Start dodging as soon as you see the cast animation for Xerath R Rite of the Arcane.
Xerath.build: First, get a way to remove or cleanse the stun from Xerath E Shocking Orb. Xerath's attacks deal magic damage, so build magic resistance instead of armor, and get movement speed to leave the telegraphed attack areas.
Xerath.fight: Close the gap right after Xerath W Eye of Destruction and Xerath E Shocking Orb are used. In small bot lane fights, wait for your support to engage instead of moving forward first, then use Ashe W Volley and basic attacks to keep enemies slowed.
Xerath.laning: Ashe has no mobility ability, so do not push the wave recklessly; keep it pulled toward you. Farm while avoiding Xerath's heavy damage. When Xerath has spent a lot of mana, push the wave and call for jungle help. Use Ashe E Hawkshot to check paths without vision before moving up.
Xerath.combo: Before the fight, basic attack minions to stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus. Once Xerath W Eye of Destruction and Xerath E Shocking Orb are down, stun him with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, add a slow with Ashe W Volley, then activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and continue basic attacking.
Xerath.escape: The moment after both Xerath W Eye of Destruction and Xerath E Shocking Orb are down is your chance to go in. Xerath has no mobility ability, so closing the gap and stunning him with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow makes it easier to stay close and attack.
Xerath.phase: Early on, respect Xerath's long range, avoid heavy damage, and farm. Later, Ashe has less burst damage than other marksmen, so stay behind your team and attack steadily.
Xerath.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and keep enemies slowed with Ashe P Frost Shot and Ashe W Volley to delay their engage. Before the fight, decide whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to engage or to stop an enemy who comes in. When you see the cast animation for Xerath R Rite of the Arcane, dodge immediately or take advantage of the fact that Xerath cannot move during it to go in.

Zeri.watch: Zeri W Ultrashock Laser spreads over a wide area when it hits terrain, so do not face Zeri with your back to a wall or in a narrow passage. Zeri E Spark Surge travels farther when it crosses a wall, so do not drive Zeri toward one. After Zeri activates Zeri R Lightning Crash, her movement speed increases; do not chase her on foot, and watch for the execute threshold of Zeri P Living Battery.
Zeri.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. The main damage from Zeri Q Burst Fire and Zeri W Ultrashock Laser is physical, so build armor first. Zeri P Living Battery deals damage based on maximum health and has an execute, so be careful about simply stacking health.
Zeri.fight: Before Zeri gets her core items, trade with the slows from Ashe W Volley and Ashe P Frost Shot to build a lead. Let your support engage first, then add your slows instead of stepping forward first. Right after you force Zeri E Spark Surge, stun Zeri with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow and fight.
Zeri.laning: Ashe has no mobility ability, so do not push the wave carelessly. Keep it near your side and stop Zeri's approach with slows. Check bushes without vision and the enemy jungler's path with Ashe E Hawkshot before moving forward. Early on, Ashe W Volley has a long cooldown and high mana cost, so use it when you are sure it will hit.
Zeri.combo: Attack minions before a fight to build stacks of Ashe Q Ranger's Focus. Once Zeri E Spark Surge is down, stun Zeri with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, slow her with Ashe W Volley, then activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and land empowered auto-attacks.
Zeri.escape: Right after you force Zeri E Spark Surge is your window to close the distance. If you also dodge the slow from Zeri W Ultrashock Laser, landing Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow will make it hard for Zeri to escape. If Zeri R Lightning Crash is active, do not chase her on foot. Fight when you can immediately stun her with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow.
Zeri.phase: In mid game, Ashe can contribute to teamfights with her slows and range once she has items. In late game, Ashe's burst damage falls behind that of other marksmen, and Zeri's mobility makes her harder to pick off, so avoid reckless chases.
Zeri.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and slow approaching enemies with Ashe P Frost Shot and Ashe W Volley. When Zeri R Lightning Crash is active, do not follow her on foot; look for a chance to stun her with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow. Before a fight, decide whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to start it or stop Zeri when she dives in.

Ziggs.watch: Stepping on Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield slows you and makes his follow-up abilities harder to dodge, so go around it or wait for it to disappear. When the warning area for Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb appears, move away from the center even if you cannot get completely out of its area. If Ziggs W Satchel Charge is available, he can escape over a wall, so check vision and routes on that side.
Ziggs.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can walk out of the warned blast area. If you build resistance against Ziggs's main damage, choose magic resistance over armor.
Ziggs.fight: Right after Ziggs uses Ziggs W Satchel Charge to poke or clear the wave is a chance to close the distance. Approach along a path free of Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield, then hold him with slows from Ashe W Volley and auto-attacks. If you built stacks of Ashe Q Ranger's Focus beforehand, land empowered auto-attacks as soon as you reach him.
Ziggs.laning: Ashe has no mobility ability, so do not push the wave carelessly. Keep it near your side and stop Ziggs's approach with the slow from Ashe P Frost Shot. Early on, Ashe W Volley has a high mana cost and long cooldown, so use it when you are sure it will hit. Check bushes without vision and the enemy jungler's path with Ashe E Hawkshot before moving forward.
Ziggs.combo: Once Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down and you see an approach free of mines, stun Ziggs first with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow. Follow with the slow from Ashe W Volley, then activate your stacked Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and keep auto-attacking.
Ziggs.escape: Go in right after Ziggs W Satchel Charge, Ziggs's escape tool, is used. If Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield blocks your approach, go around it or wait for it to disappear. Landing Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow right after Ziggs uses Ziggs W Satchel Charge makes it hard for him to escape.
Ziggs.phase: Early on, use Ashe W Volley carefully and keep the wave near your side to play safely. In mid game, contribute to fights with Ashe's slows and range. In late game, stay behind your team and keep applying slows instead of relying on burst damage.
Ziggs.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and slow approaching enemies with Ashe W Volley and auto-attacks. If Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down, look for a chance to lock Ziggs down with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow. Around objectives, avoid clustering in one spot because of Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb.

Zilean.watch: If two Zilean Q Time Bombs attach to you, you are stunned, so as soon as the first bomb attaches, move away from your allies and out of its blast radius. If Zilean E Time Warp catches you alone, his bomb combo is easier to land, so do not move ahead by yourself.
Zilean.build: Prioritize tenacity in case you take damage while caught by Zilean Q Time Bomb and Zilean E Time Warp. Magic resistance is more effective than armor against Zilean's damage, so choose magic resistance when building resistance.
Zilean.fight: After that, let your support engage, then attack while continuing the slow with Ashe W Volley and auto-attacks.
Zilean.laning: Ashe has no mobility ability, so do not push the wave carelessly; keep it near your side. Before moving forward, use Ashe E Hawkshot to check paths without vision.
Zilean.combo: Attack minions before a fight to build stacks of Ashe Q Ranger's Focus. When you have a chance to catch Zilean, stun him from long range with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, slow him with Ashe W Volley, then activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and keep auto-attacking. Do not dump your abilities into a target affected by Zilean R Chronoshift while waiting for the revive.
Zilean.escape: Dodging both Zilean Q Time Bombs creates a chance to go in. Zilean E Time Warp can be cast on only one person at a time, so approach from different directions with your allies. Once you close the distance, lock Zilean down with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow.
Zilean.phase: Use Ashe's slows and range in mid game. In late game, her burst damage falls behind, so stay behind your team and keep applying slows.
Zilean.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and slow enemies who dive in with Ashe W Volley and auto-attacks. Decide in advance whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to start a fight or stop a diver. If the enemy damage dealer is affected by Zilean R Chronoshift, switch targets to Zilean himself, and keep your distance from allies with a bomb attached.

Zyra.watch: If Zyra E Grasping Roots roots you, you can easily take follow-up damage from her plants and the knockup from Zyra R Stranglethorns. Sidestep Zyra E Grasping Roots near the end of its range, and walk out of Zyra R Stranglethorns when its summoning indicator appears. Avoid fighting where plants are clustered.
Zyra.build: The source does not specify a first purchase. Prioritize movement speed to walk out of Zyra's telegraphed areas. Consider tenacity if Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns keep you caught and taking damage, or magic resistance if you need to withstand magic damage.
Zyra.fight: Start a trade after dodging Zyra E Grasping Roots, when there are no plants nearby. Slow Zyra with Ashe W Volley when she steps forward. If your support starts the fight, keep the slow going with basic attacks.
Zyra.laning: Ashe has no escape ability, so avoid pushing the lane carelessly and keep it pulled toward you. If an ability comes your way as you move in to step on Zyra's seeds, back off, then approach again. Check bushes where you suspect an ambush and the path ahead with Ashe E Hawkshot before moving forward.
Zyra.combo: Before a fight, attack minions to stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus. If Zyra E Grasping Roots is on cooldown, stun her from long range with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, slow her with Ashe W Volley, then activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and follow up with empowered basic attacks.
Zyra.escape: The moment after you sidestep Zyra E Grasping Roots is your chance to go in. Zyra has no ability to create distance on her own, so close in from a side without plants and catch her with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow.
Zyra.phase: Early on, manage your distance with Ashe's lack of an escape in mind. In the mid game, contribute to teamfights with slows and range. Late game, focus on keeping enemies slowed rather than dealing burst damage.
Zyra.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and slow enemies coming in with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks. If Zyra has built up seeds and plants in an area, avoid fighting there and move the fight elsewhere. Before a fight, decide whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to start it or to stop an enemy who comes in.

Nilah.watch: Right after Nilah Q Formless Blade hits, her attack range and area increase, so step back farther. Watch for angles where Nilah E Slipstream can close the gap, and stop basic attacking while Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active. If Nilah R Apotheosis is available, spread out from your allies so you are not pulled in together.
Nilah.build: Nilah deals mostly physical damage and Ashe has low armor, so start with Cloth Armor to survive and choose Plated Steelcaps. Because Nilah Q Formless Blade has penetration, build health alongside armor. If the enemy support provides healing and shields, or fights run long, get Executioner's Calling for healing reduction.
Nilah.fight: When Nilah approaches to last-hit, harass her from outside her range with Ashe W Volley and the slow from Ashe P Frost Shot. When Nilah W Jubilant Veil activates, stop basic attacking and resume after it expires. If your support engages first, keep the slow going with Ashe W Volley and basic attacks.
Nilah.laning: Ashe has no mobility, so avoid pushing the wave carelessly. Keep it on your side and watch for Nilah E Slipstream engage angles. Use Ashe W Volley early only when you can land it, given its mana cost and cooldown, and check paths without vision with Ashe E Hawkshot.
Nilah.combo: Before a fight, hit minions to stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus. To stop Nilah's engage, stun her with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, follow with the slow from Ashe W Volley, then activate Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and land empowered basic attacks. If Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active, wait until it expires before basic attacking.
Nilah.escape: After Nilah uses Nilah E Slipstream and Nilah W Jubilant Veil, Ashe has a chance to counterattack. Nilah E Slipstream has a short cooldown, so do not move in first just because she used it; stun her with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow before attacking. If Nilah R Apotheosis is available, do not move in close together.
Nilah.phase: In mid game, help teamfights with your slow and range. In late game, maintain slows from behind your allies instead of relying on burst damage.
Nilah.teamfight: From behind your frontline, slow Nilah's engage with Ashe W Volley and Ashe P Frost Shot. If Nilah R Apotheosis is available, spread out from your allies. If you have already been pulled in, attack Nilah immediately to stop her from completing the cast. Decide beforehand whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to start the fight or stop Nilah's engage.

Yasuo.watch: Yasuo E Sweeping Blade lets him use minions to approach, so do not let him close the gap where there are many minions. Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has a narrow hitbox; move sideways as he approaches, and watch for the knockup when you see the tornado ready effect. Yasuo W Wind Wall blocks projectiles, so hold Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow and go around the wall or wait for it to disappear.
Yasuo.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive early, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Yasuo deals mostly physical damage and Ashe has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Yasuo.fight: Trigger Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer shield with a basic attack before dealing serious damage, and keep your distance with the slow from Ashe P Frost Shot. Right after you dodge the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest is your chance to go in. Hit minions before a fight to stack Ashe Q Ranger's Focus.
Yasuo.laning: Do not push the wave carelessly. Keep it toward your side to reduce the minions Yasuo can use with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. At low levels, Ashe W Volley has a long cooldown and high mana cost, so use it when you can reliably land it. Check bushes without vision and the enemy jungler's path with Ashe E Hawkshot before moving forward.
Yasuo.combo: Once Yasuo W Wind Wall disappears, stun him with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow while there is still distance between you. Follow with the slow from Ashe W Volley, then activate your prestacked Ashe Q Ranger's Focus and continue with empowered basic attacks.
Yasuo.escape: Do not go in immediately just because Yasuo used one Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Engage when you can stun him with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow after dodging the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back up.
Yasuo.phase: In mid game, contribute to teamfights with Ashe's slow and range. In late game, apply slows continuously from behind your allies instead of relying on burst damage.
Yasuo.teamfight: From behind your frontline, slow Yasuo's engage with Ashe P Frost Shot and Ashe W Volley. Before the fight, decide whether to use Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow to initiate or stop Yasuo when he comes in. If your allies group up, move with them and do not go forward alone.
